text:
ava: Heads up 1: our weekly KPI dashboard shows a sudden +180% uplift in webinar signups starting 07:12 UTC. Is this legit or a tagging issue?
nico: I see the same on the Launch > Cohort page. Pageviews also spiked. Pulling GA now.
tara: Quick question 1: did we run any paid promo or partner list at 07:10? I don't recall a send.
pete: I scheduled a micro-test email for cohorts 3/4 at 06:58 but it was supposed to be paused. Checking send logs.
analytics-bot: Log: email-job-447 status=sent scheduled=2026-03-25T06:58:00Z recipients=1,200 template=cohort-update-v3
ava: That explains behavior if the micro-test hit a subset of partners. Two tracker items: 1) confirm UTM consistency; 2) confirm lead assignment/queue mapping for these signups.
nico: Quick GA snippet: traffic source column shows utm_campaign values: [cohort_q2_launch, cohort_q2]. Some hits have `utm_medium=partner` while others `utm_medium=email`.
tara: Ugly. Our attribution rules treat `utm_campaign` literally so cohort_q2 and cohort_q2_launch are separate. We should unify to cohort_q2.
pete: Can we add a derived field in the dashboard ETL `campaign_normalized` so we don't mutate original data? We should map {cohort_q2_launch -> cohort_q2}.
analytics-bot: Action queued: create mapping rule `normalize_campaign_cohort_q2` in ETL. ETA 2h.
ava: For the KPI readout, please add a footnote and a quick table: raw leads, normalized leads, and percent difference. Also include conversion from visit->signup from GA vs SFDC to spot any drop.
nico: I'll add a small table and two sparkline charts. Also recommend we check MQL conversion for this cohort vs baseline (last 7 days) to detect noisy signups.
tara: Agree. If quality is lower, label this as "test-surge" in the weekly notes and exclude from trendline smoothing.
pete: Ops note: I've paused the micro-test and will version the template. Also adding an internal tag to the campaign links: `?partner_test=cohort_q2_v3` so future sends self-annotate.
analytics-bot: Webhook emitted: /internal/events/email-send with payload campaign=cohort_q2_v3 recipients=1200 timestamp=2026-03-25T06:58:00Z
ava: Nice. Two small asks before 09:30 KPI call: 1) nico, please surface both raw and normalized numbers on slide 2; 2) tara, add a 1-line recommendation (exclude vs annotate) for the exec summary.
nico: On it. Slide will show: visits, signups, signup rate, signups_normalized, MQL_rate. Will add footnote about mapping rule.
tara: I'll draft the recommendation: "Annotate as partner test surge; exclude from 7-day trend smoothing unless normalized series confirms sustained lift."
ava: Meeting at 09:30 stand 10 minutes to finalize. Thanks all.
pete: Pulling the mapping PR now and will ping when deployed.
analytics-bot: Dashboard annotation added: "partner-test surge detected: cohort_q2_v3"
ava: Closing thread. See you on the KPI call. :white_check_mark:
